notes.title: Starblast Modding Space is live
notes.notes:
Modding Space is out!

So you can now play anytime Finalizer's U-Series (version 1.7, more on this below), Starblast Racing or Battle Royale (which is now considered as a mod, making it permanent).

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30712488/e9349ed73dac8707bce45f75b5af2c775308ff8a.jpg[/img] [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30712488/8bdb784f5a5802f3ea240c09f929a580400c4ce7.jpg[/img] [img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30712488/d8d2138ad076007c1d367c0d7b0d27f060072524.jpg[/img]

Finalizer reworked his mod for better balance. The USS-Vengeance was replaced by the (awesome) U-Fusion (which I would call BFG if someone asked me).

The bug in Racing mod, which caused laps to be miscounted, is fixed (was a problem in the modding system itself).

Battle Royale now has a warm up phase (since the last BR event) allowing to have some fun while waiting for more players to join.

There are many more amazing mods already being worked on by the community and many of them should become available in the Modding Space soon. All this with a still limited set of modding features, you can expect much more for the future! This is just the beginning.

Thanks a lot to all the modding community, mod creators and ship designers, and let the fun begin!

notes.title: Update: 32bit Windows and windowed mode
notes.notes:
We have updated the standalone and Steam client today:
[list]
  [*] Windows 32 bit systems are now supported
  [*] You can now switch between fullscreen or windowed mode using Alt+Enter
[/list]

Besides this, there has been a number of improvements and fixes to the core game since the launch on Steam:

2017-11-28
* Improved invasion mode rankings (now shows number of victories)

2017-11-27
* Battle Royale custom games

2017-11-21
* New: invasion mode leaderboard!
* Repulsive field improved (survival mode)
* changed condition for closing team mode games (time>15 min)

2017-11-20
* Increased radar range in invasion mode.

2017-11-16
* Fixed problem with explosion sounds
* Fixed bug with music volume in invasion mode
* Fixed RCS button bug on touch screens
* Added possibility to start invasion mode private games
* A bit more crystals and weapons in invasion waves 1 and 2
* Fixed countdown display in invasion mode wave zero
* Added volume sliders for music and sound fx in game settings

2017-11-14
* Invasion mode balance improvements
* Improved radar in invasion mode
* Fixed friendly collisions (all team modes)

2017-11-10
* Invasion mode balance update

Full updated changelog is always accessible here:
 [url=https://starblast.io/changelog.txt] starblast.io/changelog.txt [/url]
